evidence.detail: The nested class has exactly two final instance fields: int shader type and String filename, initialized by a two-argument constructor and exposed by integer/String accessors.
R89 Shader stores these objects in its unit list, reads the integer as the OpenGL shader type and the String as the Template resource filename during shader compilation.
The public RuneLite-derived Shader source preserves an exact nested class named Unit with final int type and final String filename, the same constructor shape, and the same compile-loop use.
The enclosing exact-v308 owner rs/k/m is independently R89 Shader, fixing the nested source identity as Shader.Unit rather than a generic unrelated two-field record.

proposals.note: Unit is an exact nested Shader source-name/structure match. The enclosing owner is independently identified as R89 Shader, and no prior Chat 2 semantic proposal uses the simple name Unit.
